mapper.select: SELECT h.reg_dttm, CASE h.trgt_tbl_nm WHEN 'TB_SY_CODE_GRP' THEN '그룹' WHEN 'TB_SY_CODE' THEN '코드' WHEN 'TB_SY_OPER_STD' THEN '운영 기준값' WHEN 'TB_SY_CODE_MAP' THEN '표기 대응' END AS kind, COALESCE(h.chg_item_nm, h.trgt_key) AS item, COALESCE(h.bfr_val, '') AS before_value, COALESCE(h.aft_val, '') AS after_value, h.reg_user_id FROM TB_SY_CHG_HIST h WHERE h.trgt_tbl_nm IN ('TB_SY_CODE_GRP', 'TB_SY_CODE', 'TB_SY_OPER_STD', 'TB_SY_CODE_MAP') ORDER BY h.reg_dttm DESC, h.hist_id DESC
